entry_state: Chapter14 ends with separate engineering,accounting,forecast and human acceptance requirements. Corpus acquisition and configurable workload limits do not establish semantic completeness or measured capacity. AppendixA begins as a lookup reference after the body teaches the operations. CorporateJointHistory,CompanyComposition and RealDisclosureConnection preserve typed evidence,transaction ownership,partial answers and finite documentary scope. source.prepare constructs extraction candidates;review.propose constructs a proposed decision and accepts no layer. The review.commit entry follows.
exit_state: The primitive registry distinguishes review,temporal selection,compilation,history construction,uncertainty admission/selection,projection,accounting and storage effects. Closed records bind accounting basis and authorization without forward receipt references; synthetic evidence cannot authorize a real-book posting. Method definitions preserve unknown preconditions and capability limits. OrderedEPS/1 defines exact context-bound rational inputs,complete inventories and chronology,ordered comparisons and distinct unresolved/unsupported/blocked/rejected results. Its report mutates nothing and leaves live freshness and source truth to application methods.

findings.observation: The concise operation entries preserve body-defined effects: evaluation does not select,assessment does not authorize,and import does not admit accounting facts.
Field listings are implementation references with local decoding and rejection rules. EPS preserves independently ready basic results while refusing an unsupported diluted calculation.
